jobs.title: Creative Director(Content Strategist)
jobs.description:
We’re seeking an experienced Creative Manager with a strong agency background and established creative networks across Dubai and India.

The ideal candidate will have experience collaborating with international agencies, managing creative partnerships and leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality campaigns across markets.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead creative strategy, campaign development and execution across multiple projects.

\* Manage creative teams and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners.

\* Build and maintain relationships with creative, branding, advertising and digital agencies in Dubai and India, as well as international markets.

\* Identify and manage external agency partnerships to support creative delivery and business objectives.

\* Ensure consistency in brand identity, creative quality and campaign execution.

\* Oversee project timelines, budgets, resources and deliverables.

\* Translate business requirements into impactful creative solutions for diverse audiences.

Requirements

\* Proven experience as a Creative Manager or in a comparable creative leadership position.

\* Strong background in a creative, advertising, branding or digital agency.

\* Demonstrated experience managing creative teams and external agency relationships.

\* Existing professional networks across Dubai and India; international agency exposure is a strong advantage.

\* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative strategy, campaign delivery and brand development.

\* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and organisational skills.

Who We’re Looking For

A commercially aware creative professional who can bridge creative talent, agency partnerships and business objectives across markets.

Pay: From AED8,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience taking an idea from inception to execution?
* What is your salary expectation ?
* Will you require visa sponsorship?

Experience:

* Content creation: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Art Director
jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Art Director, you'll lead the visual development of high-impact creative concepts and scalable key visual systems that anchor brand and social presence across the MEA region, flexing seamlessly across in-store activations, experiential touchpoints, print, OOH, and digital/social platforms while leveraging advanced generative AI workflows to accelerate concepting and production. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Lead the visual direction and craft for integrated campaigns spanning experiential events, retail/POS activations, print, out-of-home, and digital touchpoints.
* Partner closely with copywriters to concept big, cohesive campaign ideas from scratch that translate across both physical and digital ecosystems.
* Develop extensible campaign Key Visuals (KVs) that serve as the foundational visual identity for full social content systems, graphic design rollouts, and multi-channel adaptations.
* Champion and embed generative AI tools (such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway) into creative pipelines to rapidly visualize concepts, explore visual directions, and streamline asset adaptation.
* Direct photoshoots, CGI pipelines, and retouching processes, creating precise briefs for photographers, stylists, model talent, and post-production specialists.
* Oversee production quality and execution integrity by collaborating with vendors and production partners on material selection, print specifications, and on-site builds.
* Present creative concepts, KVs, and craft rationales to senior client stakeholders with strategic clarity and conviction.
* Partner cross-functionally with strategists, designers, and producers to safeguard visual consistency and brand guidelines throughout the campaign lifecycle.

### **About You**

### **The essentials:**

* Full professional fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is essential, with the proven ability to concept, craft, and art direct in both languages.
* 8+ years of creative agency experience with a demonstrated track record leading BTL campaigns, large-scale experiential activations, and social-first creative work.
* Strong, award-caliber portfolio exhibiting conceptual depth, craft excellence, and scalable visual systems across diverse formats.
* Hands-on proficiency using generative AI tools (e.g., Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, ChatGPT) within modern creative and production workflows.
* Deep cultural intelligence and strong command of consumer nuances across Dubai and the wider MEA region.
* Exceptional presentation, client leadership, and storytelling capabilities.
* Collaborative, solutions-oriented leadership style with uncompromising standards for creative quality.

### **Not a must, but a plus:**

* Experience art directing motion design, 3D/CGI, or immersive interactive experiences.
* Prior experience working within global creative network agency environments.
* Relevant degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or Advertising.

jobs.title: AI Video Production Team (4 Roles Open)
jobs.description:
We are scaling our media pipeline and hiring a powerhouse team of 4 AI Video Specialists to produce high-end, cinematic AI video content. We are looking for creators who understand that AI tools generate the frames, but human artistry makes the film.

Positions: AI Video Directors / Editors (3 Openings)

Looking for technical creatives who can act as a "Director in the prompt box" and polished post-production editors.  
What you need:

* Cinematic AI Prompting: Ability to control generative engines like a real director. Your text/image-to-video prompts must explicitly control camera movements (e.g., orbits, pans, tilts), lighting setups (e.g., volumetric, high-contrast, cinematic styles), and audio/mood dynamics.
* Character & Scene Consistency: Mastery of maintaining asset continuity across multiple generations and tools (e.g., Runway, Sora, Midjourney, Kling, or specialized pipelines).
* Traditional Post-Production: Advanced editing skills using industry software (such as Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects).
* Pacing & Sound Design: Ability to clean up AI outputs, fix continuity flaws, build seamless shot transitions, and layer high-quality sound effects/music.

General Requirements:

* A portfolio or showreel showcasing actual AI-generated video work is mandatory.
* Deep understanding of structural prompting frameworks to keep generation iterations cost-effective.
* Already located in the UAE.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Mandatory):

* Scriptwriting experience
* Proficiency in the Arabic language

jobs.title: Senior Creative Director
jobs.description:
TAIT partners with artists, brands, IP holders and place makers to bring culture-defining, never-before-seen experiences to life. With a legacy of innovation spanning over 45 years, TAIT has grown from pioneering in rock ‘n’ roll concert staging to setting the global standard for extraordinary live events and experiences through cutting-edge technology, precision engineering, and creative design. TAIT’s 20 global offices have developed iconic productions and experiences in over 30 countries, all seven continents, and even outer space for renowned performers, theme parks, exhibits, and venues across the globe, including partnerships with Taylor Swift, Cirque Du Soleil, Royal Opera House, Nike, NASA, Bloomberg, Google, Beyoncé, and The Olympics

**Position Purpose**

The Senior Creative Director position is primarily responsible for leading and contributing to the creative development of a variety of projects for the Company to meet the Client’s expectations and the Company’s quality guidelines. This position includes managing the original creation of new creative material for the Company’s projects, participating and contributing in brainstormings & charrettes, contributing to already developed concepts by others and acting as creative lead on all projects.

This position may include the participation and preparation of other non-project specific assignments, such as speech and editorial writing and preparation, marketing materials copywriting, RFQ/RFP positioning statements, white papers and other writing as deemed necessary by the Company. Participation will be required in presentations, meetings, production meetings, field trips, research and other projects as necessary. The Senior Creative Director will act as a representative of the Company to clients, professional organizations, and the media.

**Responsibilities**

The Senior Creative Director will set and communicate the creative direction for major, multidisciplinary guest experiences—articulating the big picture in an inspiring way and leading from pitch through final installation. They will drive concepts (including major IPs) in complex stakeholder environments; mentor and manage creative teams; align with business and brand strategy; and ensure operational, financial, and experiential feasibility. They will uphold creative quality, strengthen client relationships, and represent TAIT with passion, clarity, and composure across presentations, industry forums, and solo client engagements.

* Visualize and communicate the overarching creative vision in a clear, inspiring, and motivating way.
* Lead creative across all phases—concept, design, tender, production, installation/programming—for attractions, exhibits, interactives, and integrated experiences.
* Drive pitching and proposals: generate ideas with internal teams; lead kick‑offs and creative work sessions; craft persuasive pitch materials.
* Develop, write, and lead IP‑based concepts; ensure brand/IP compliance and alignment across complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Manage and or mentor talent (including Creative Directors); inspire cross‑functional teams and model passion, positivity, and creative rigor.
* Own narrative deliverables: oversee briefs, summaries, treatments, outlines, narratives, and scripts; augment with mood boards, storyboards, and reference media.
* Ensure feasibility and delivery: partner with SMEs to validate operational, financial, and experiential viability; collaborate with PM/PE to manage scope, schedule, budget; identify and mitigate risks; respond constructively to feedback.
* Maintain creative quality control throughout the lifecycle, including TAIT senior leadership reviews; lead client/stakeholder presentations and develop presentation materials.
* Partner across content and production: collaborate with producers and the Head of Content; incorporate feedback while protecting creative intent.
* Manage multiple projects end‑to‑end, keeping an open, adaptive process to accommodate pivots and resource realignment.
* Advance business and brand goals: develop creative programs and design concepts that meet client objectives; apply appropriate brand voice and ensure brand compliance.
* Optimize workflow and resources to meet timelines and deliverables; align staffing with project priorities.
* Work with vendors to realize creative intent and resolve challenges collaboratively.
* Research industry trends, technologies, and client context to inform and elevate creative development.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures; identify and communicate critical issues and milestones promptly.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Contribute to departmental growth through industry representation, competitions, technology exploration, marketing support, and educational outreach.
* Additional duties as needed

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Design, Architecture, Humanities, or related field; Master's degree a plus.
* 12+ years of demonstrable experience in storytelling, creative ideation & leadership in the industry, including significant experience with high-level stakeholders on major projects.
* 12+ years of significant demonstrable major client facing and handling experiences.
* Significant experience exhibiting creative leadership in service to, and managing the portfolios for, major entertainment industry clients (including project development in the areas of LBE and/or placemaking).
* Excellent collaboration skills, and comfortable working as part of several teams simultaneously.
* Strong computer skills: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Lucid, and Keynote
* Proven communication and presentation skills: written and verbal
* Understanding of the entertainment industry and participating in or leading a creative process
* Proven experience in constantly multitask and handling competing priorities between client business needs, organizational issues, and sound customer relations
